lead: A host-made `borrow` and a guest that keeps its `borrow` both fail a component call at runtime, not at load.
body: wasmtime 48 lowers `Resource::new_borrow` from the host only inside a host call's scope (`BUG: no current scope` panic), and the canonical ABI traps an export that returns while still holding a borrow it received ("borrow handles still remain at the end of the call"). Lend a `borrow` parameter from a host-owned resource (`Resource::new_own`, dropped after the call), and have a WAT guest `resource.drop` each borrow it received (`crates/nvs-ext/src/handle.rs`).
